mission.title: Our mission
content: Our mission is to bring together professionals, enthusiasts, and innovators in the field of UI and UX to share knowledge, experiences, and emerging trends that shape the future of user interface and user experience design.
The conference aims to inspire participants to explore new perspectives, enhance their skills, and adopt modern technologies and best practices that improve human interaction with technology.
We aspire to create a space where attendees can learn from industry leaders, explore innovative approaches to design, and establish connections that support their professional growth.
We believe that exceptional user experiences begin with understanding users' needs, and our conference is a step toward building better and more user-friendly digital products.

info: UI and UX – Key Design Concepts for Effective Digital Products

In the dynamic world of technology, users expect digital products to be not only functional but also user-friendly. At this conference, we’ll dive into the distinctions and synergy between UI (User Interface) and UX (User Experience) – two pillars of effective design.

User Interface (UI): The art of visually designing user interactions. UI encompasses graphical elements that shape the first impression – buttons, icons, color schemes, typography, and the overall layout, which make the product visually appealing and intuitive to use.

User Experience (UX): The process of creating a positive user journey from the first interaction with a product. UX focuses on designing flow and functionality to help users achieve their goals quickly and easily while providing them with valuable experiences. Good UX means not only convenience but also user engagement, leading to satisfaction.
Join us at the conference to explore modern techniques, best practices, and strategies for integrating UI and UX, creating digital products that captivate users and deliver memorable experiences.

speakers.name: Dr. Anna Kowalska
speakers.title: Lead UX Designer at TechNow Innovations
speakers.description: Dr. Anna Kowalska is a user experience expert with extensive experience in researching user behavior in mobile applications. Her current projects focus on leveraging artificial intelligence to personalize user interactions, enabling the creation of more intuitive and tailored solutions. Dr. Kowalska will present her latest research findings and share practical insights on implementing AI in UX design.

speakers.name: Jan Nowak
speakers.title: Innovation Director at PixelWave
speakers.description: Jan Nowak is a visionary in AR and VR technologies, successfully integrating cutting-edge solutions into UI projects for the education and entertainment industries. During his presentation, Jan will discuss the opportunities that augmented and virtual reality offer for creating immersive and interactive user experiences. Attendees will learn how to effectively use these technologies in their projects.

speakers.name: Magdalena Wiśniewska
speakers.title: Senior UX Specialist at WebMaster Pro
speakers.description: With over 10 years of experience in designing responsive and accessible interfaces, Magdalena Wiśniewska is a pioneer in creating solutions tailored to the needs of people with disabilities. At the conference, Magdalena will showcase best practices and modern accessibility solutions that foster inclusion in the digital environment. Her presentation is a must-attend for designers focused on inclusivity.

speakers.name: Tomasz Zieliński
speakers.title: CEO and Co-founder of Creatify
speakers.description: Tomasz Zieliński is an entrepreneur passionate about user-centered design and the co-founder of Creatify, an agency specializing in e-commerce. Tomasz will demonstrate how a user-focused approach impacts conversions and customer satisfaction, sharing examples from his projects. His talk will provide valuable insights for those looking to enhance their e-commerce platforms with a user experience focus.

speakers.name: Dr. Marta Nowicka
speakers.title: Human-Computer Interaction Expert at SmartLab
speakers.description: Dr. Marta Nowicka is a researcher specializing in ergonomics and the efficiency of human-computer interactions. She focuses on designing user-friendly solutions for the healthcare sector. In her presentation, Dr. Nowicka will discuss how ergonomic design can influence user health and productivity, presenting findings from her medical sector research.

speakers.name: Piotr Wojciechowski
speakers.title: UI Designer at DigitalCraft
speakers.description: Piotr Wojciechowski, known for his minimalist design approach, specializes in crafting aesthetic desktop and mobile interfaces. His work stands out for its elegance and simplicity, with color theory playing a key role in his designs. Piotr will share his design philosophy and the tools he uses to create unique and intuitive interfaces.

speakers.name: Agnieszka Malinowska
speakers.title: UX Researcher at Smart Path
speakers.description: Agnieszka Malinowska specializes in user research, which forms the foundation for UX product design. Her work involves data analysis and A/B testing to help designers better understand user needs. At the conference, Agnieszka will discuss the best qualitative and quantitative research methods and how to extract actionable insights from them.

speakers.name: Krzysztof Wiatr
speakers.title: Voice Interface Specialist at VoiceFuture
speakers.description: Krzysztof Wiatr is an expert in voice interfaces, working on touchless interaction solutions for years. He specializes in designing intuitive systems for virtual assistants and smart home devices. His presentation will focus on the future of voice interfaces, highlighting the challenges and opportunities they bring to UX.

speakers.name: Maria Kozłowska
speakers.title: Lead UI Designer at BrightWorks
speakers.description: Maria Kozłowska leads a team of UI designers with experience in large-scale corporate projects. She specializes in maintaining visual consistency in complex projects. During the conference, Maria will discuss the challenges of working on extensive projects and demonstrate how to ensure visual coherence and client satisfaction.

speakers.name: Paweł Sikora
speakers.title: User Psychology Specialist at UserSense
speakers.description: Paweł Sikora combines psychology and UX expertise to create engaging and motivating interfaces. He analyzes how colors, typography, and other visual elements impact users' emotions. At the conference, Paweł will explore the psychological aspects of design that attract attention and boost user engagement.

sessions.description: Practical tips and best practices for designing user-friendly interfaces for all users, with a focus on accessibility.

sessions.title: Presentation: “User-Centered Design in E-Commerce”
sessions.speaker: Tomasz Zieliński, Creatify
sessions.description: Tomasz Zieliński will demonstrate how user-centered design impacts the success of e-commerce platforms and enhances customer satisfaction.

sessions.title: Panel Discussion: “Ergonomics and Efficiency in Designing Interfaces for the Healthcare Sector”
sessions.description: A discussion on the specifics of designing for the healthcare sector and the impact of ergonomics on interface efficiency.

sessions.title: Day Summary and Session Closure
sessions.description: A brief session summarizing the key points of the day.

sessions.title: Registration
sessions.description: Participants can register and start the day with informal networking.

sessions.title: Workshop: “Minimalism and Color Theory in UI Design”
sessions.description: A workshop focused on a minimalist approach to design and the application of color theory to create elegant and clear interfaces.

sessions.title: Presentation: “User Data Analysis for Better UX”
sessions.description: Agnieszka Malinowska will discuss tools and techniques for analyzing user data and how they contribute to designing a user-friendly UX.

sessions.title: Presentation: “Voice and Touchless Interfaces – The Future of Interaction”
sessions.description: An overview of the role of voice interfaces and their impact on users’ daily interactions with technology, particularly in smart home and virtual assistant contexts.

sessions.title: Presentation: “Maintaining Visual Consistency in Large Corporate Projects”
sessions.description: Maria Kozłowska will share her experience in large-scale UI design, addressing the challenges of maintaining consistency in visual identity.

sessions.title: Presentation: “User Psychology: Motivation, Emotions, and Engagement”
sessions.description: A presentation on the role of psychology in UX, analyzing user emotions and motivations, and the impact of visual elements on user engagement.

sessions.title: Conference Closing and Summary
sessions.description: A recap of key takeaways from the two-day conference and a thank-you to participants and speakers.

directions.details: From major cities: TechVille is located a 2-hour drive from the capital, with convenient access via the A1 and S5 highways. Parking facilities are available near the conference venue for participants.

From major cities: Regular bus connections operated by QuickBus and CityConnect. The "TechVille Center" stop is a 10-minute walk from the conference venue.
City connections: TechVille offers a public transport system providing easy access to key city locations.

Nearest train station: "TechVille Main," a 15-minute walk from the conference venue.
Connections: Direct routes from major cities operated by InterCity and ExpressLine.

Nearest airport: TechVille Airport (TVL), located 20 km from the city center.
Transfers: Airport shuttles and bus lines connect the airport to TechVille's city center.
